commits_data.message:
MySQL: Better handling of compressed state

See also: https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/issues/19050#note_1381721377

This handles the `conn_data->state` and `conn_data->compressed_state` in
a similar way to store the compressed state in the first pass and re-use
this afterwards.
